candidate_name: C-10 block gas (Shell / QatarEnergy / SMH) — potential future LNG
sponsor_or_proposer: Shell (50% operator); QatarEnergy (40%); Societe Mauritanienne des Hydrocarbures (SMH, 10%)
current_state: Exploration only. Shell signed the C-10 PSA in July 2018 (90% interest); QatarEnergy farmed into 40% in 2023. Block sits ~50 km off the Mauritanian coast, ~11,500 km2, water depths 50-2,000 m. No commercial gas discovery, no liquefaction/FLNG plan, and no terminal proposal announced as of mid-2026.
missing_threshold_elements: No concrete step toward an LNG terminal (no discovery declared, no FEED/MOU/site for a liquefaction or regas facility); pre-discovery exploration acreage. Sponsor and approximate location are known, but the concrete-step and (LNG-)facility-existence tests fail.
watch_for: A commercial gas discovery announcement on C-10; any move to monetize C-10 gas via a dedicated FLNG unit or tie-back to the GTA hub (vs. domestic gas-to-power). Re-check in ~12 months.
notes: Logged so the same exploration block is not re-discovered every sweep. NOT a terminal: it is upstream acreage. C-10 / QatarEnergy 40% farm-in / Shell operator confirmed by 3 independent non-GEM sources, all PASSED url_verifier (token 'C-10' unless noted): JPT/SPE (best lead), World Oil ('Shell, QatarEnergy sign agreement for exploration offshore Africa'), and Energy Capital & Power ('QatarEnergy Acquires 40% Interest in Block C-10 Offshore Mauritania'); Energy Connects also corroborates (token 'Mauritania'). Distinct project from the GTA, BirAllah, and Banda terminals. No gem.wiki citation used.
